title: Prescription Intake Note on the Ordered Cartridge Rate (Insulin Pump Program)
content:
The ordered rate of a cartridge or reservoir refill on an Insulin Pump Program follows the program's written orders for the cartridge item (A4232 for a MiniMed 780G, A4225 for every other model), in three cases:

- **Recent order.** Where a written order for the item is dated in the three months before the ship date, the standard ordered rate is replaced with the newest written order's quantity per 30 days.
- **Older order with a refill history.** Where the newest written order for the item is older than that and the program has a previous refill of the item, it is replaced with the lesser of that order's quantity per 30 days and the previous refill's units times 30 divided by its supply days, rounded up.
- **Any other case.** The standard ordered rate stands.

An order counts as dated in the three months before the ship date when its order date is later than the same day of the month three months before the ship date. The newest written order is the one with the latest order date; the previous refill is the program's latest earlier refill shipment of the item.

| Hypothetical records | Ordered rate |
|---|---|
| Order dated 6 weeks before the ship date, 12 per 30 days | replaced with 12 |
| Newest order dated 8 months before, 15 per 30 days; previous refill 36 units over 90 days | 36 times 30 is 1,080; divided by 90 is 12; replaced with the lesser of 15 and 12, which is 12 |
| Newest order dated 8 months before, 10 per 30 days; previous refill 40 units over 90 days | 40 times 30 divided by 90 is 13.33, rounded up to 14; replaced with the lesser of 10 and 14, which is 10 |
